mfg1-electrical-l078.title: Synchronous speed, mechanical output, at starting methods
mfg1-electrical-l078.objective: Hiwalay na basahin ang synchronous/actual speed, input, at shaft output.

paragraphs.title: Field speed at rotor
paragraphs.text: Synchronous speed ng rotating field ay Ns=120 f/p. Sa 50 Hz・4 poles, 1500 min⁻¹; karaniwang mas mabagal ang loaded induction rotor at may slip. Hindi unconditional actual-speed guarantee ang formula.

paragraphs.title: Output mula torque
paragraphs.text: Shaft power P=2πNT/60, N actual rpm min⁻¹, T N·m. Sa 600 min⁻¹ at 2 N·m, humigit-kumulang 126 W. Ihiwalay ang input at shaft output kasama ang losses; hindi pahintulot lumampas sa rating ang computed power.

paragraphs.title: Starting conditions
paragraphs.text: Piliin ang full-voltage, star-delta, compensator, reactor sa gamit/equipment. May winding/connection assumptions ang star-delta current reduction. Huwag sariling palit ng terminals; tingnan ang starting current, load, protection.

terms.meaning: Rotating-field speed ayon sa supply frequency at poles.
Daming nagpapahayag ng difference ng synchronous at rotor speed.

mfg1-electrical-l078.activity:
Gabay na 30 minuto: 10 pag-unawa sa teksto, 8 pag-aayos ng halimbawa, 9 pagsulat, 3 pagbalik-tanaw.
Kunin ang synchronous speed sa 60 Hz・6 poles at ipaliwanag kung bakit hindi pareho sa measured 980 min⁻¹. Kalkulahin ang shaft output sa 900 min⁻¹・4 N·m.
safety: Huwag basta baguhin ang terminals/phase sequence upang subukan ang speed/direction.
mfg1-electrical-l078.summary: Hiwalay na basahin ang synchronous/actual speed, input, at shaft output.
